style: Cinematic film still, 35mm, shallow depth of field, natural skin texture, no text, no captions, no watermark.

stills.prompt: Medium shot of a soul singer standing perfectly still in an empty, seamless white room, facing the camera, eyes closed. Androgynous, ageless face that is calm and slightly too symmetrical, as if averaged from many faces. Short dark natural hair, warm brown skin. Wearing a plain, unbranded light grey crew-neck t-shirt and grey trousers. Soft even top light, minimal shadows, subject centered with headroom.

The same person as the reference image, same face and hair, now performing on a 1970s TV soul-show stage. Wearing a sharp burgundy velvet suit with wide lapels over a black open-collar shirt. Standing at a vintage chrome microphone on a stand, singing straight to camera with eyes open. Behind them a glittering silver sparkle curtain, warm amber stage lights and soft haze. Medium close-up, face clearly visible and well lit, mouth slightly open mid-note.

The same person as the reference image, same face and hair, now a polished corporate assistant. Crisp white button-down shirt, seated behind a clean minimalist white desk with a closed laptop, soft diffuse office lighting, pale blue-grey modern office background. Friendly attentive expression, looking at camera. Medium shot.

A small bright orange-red cartoonish but photoreal lobster sitting upright on the keyboard of an open silver laptop on a wooden desk in a cozy home office, claws raised as if singing into a tiny microphone made from a pen. Warm lamp light, bookshelf and a plant softly out of focus behind. Medium close-up, charming and slightly absurd.

The same person as the reference image, same face and hair, now a pirate captain. Black tricorn hat, weathered brown leather coat, white linen shirt. Standing on the wooden deck of a tall ship at golden hour, ropes and sails behind, ocean glinting. Same framing as the reference: centered medium shot, facing the camera, eyes open.

The same person as the reference image, same face and hair, now a late-night software engineer. Charcoal hoodie, in a dark room lit only by the cool blue glow of a monitor off to one side, a second monitor with code softly out of focus behind. Same framing as the reference: centered medium shot, facing the camera, eyes open.

The same person as the reference image, same face and hair, now a gentle therapist. Oatmeal knit cardigan over a soft collared shirt, seated in a worn leather armchair holding a notepad and pen, warm lamp light, bookshelves and a potted plant behind. Same framing as the reference: medium shot, facing the camera, kind listening expression.

The same person as the reference image, same grey t-shirt and hair, now sitting on the floor of the same seamless white room at night, seen from behind and slightly to the side, facing away from camera toward a blank wall. The room is dim; the only light is a soft cool blue glow from an unseen screen off frame. Melancholy, quiet, lots of negative space. Wide shot.
